title: Login: complete the flow with fully valid data
steps: Add a product to the cart
Proceed to checkout and fill in the required details
expected_result: The order completes and a confirmation message is shown

title: Login: attempt the flow with an invalid or locked account
steps: Enter credentials that are invalid or belong to a locked account
expected_result: Login is rejected and a clear error message is shown

title: Login: attempt the flow with a required field left empty
steps: Leave a required field (username or password) empty
expected_result: The action is blocked and a 'field required' error message is shown

title: Login: attempt the flow with exactly one item / minimum valid input
steps: Add exactly one product to the cart
expected_result: The cart shows exactly one item with the correct count badge

title: Login: reach the same goal via a different valid path
steps: Reach the cart via a different valid navigation path
expected_result: The same cart contents are reachable either way

title: Login: attempt the flow while the app returns an error page
steps: Trigger a condition that would normally cause a server or network error
expected_result: The app shows a graceful error message instead of crashing
